postings.description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone’s life.
Your steady execution, creative problem-solving, and commitment to quality create a foundation that allows innovation to happen and success to grow.
As a Cloud Security Specialist on our Corporate Functions team, you ensure processes run efficiently, you bring clarity, and dependable support to the heart of the company.
Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

You will be responsible for strengthening cloud security and compliance across hybrid environments by implementing and monitoring security controls, managing security tooling, and translating security requirements into effective technical solutions.

- Develop, maintain and continuously improve security policies for secure configuration and hardening of client and server resources in hybrid environments
- Translate governance requirements, security standards and stakeholder input into actionable and technical controls within tools such as Wiz and CIS Security Suite
- Administer, maintain and optimize CSPM and related security tools to support cloud security posture and compliance monitoring
- Support the implementation of security controls and work with other teams to address findings and compliance gaps
- Monitor cloud security posture, control effectiveness and compliance coverage across supported environments
- Contribute to automation and continuous improvement of cloud security monitoring and compliance processes

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

We are looking for a technical problem-solver with strong analytical skills and a hands-on approach. You should be enthusiastic about working directly with tool configurations, customizing settings beyond standard templates, and focusing on automation, scalability, and effectiveness.

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, or an equivalent field of study
- Strong experience in security hardening, configuration management and preventive security controls in hybrid enterprise environments
- Hands-on experience working with CSPM platforms and security benchmark frameworks, ideally including Wiz and CIS Security Suite
- Good understanding of cloud security principles and security controls across public cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, GCP
- Proven ability to translate governance and compliance requirements into technical implementations and monitoring capabilities
- Good stakeholder management skills and experience working across security, IT, and governance functions, with strong ability to align and collaborate with cross-functional teams
- Fluency in English

Please send us your CV in English.

Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role

As Cyber & Information Security Governance Specialist, you will play a key role in our Governance team within Corporate Cyber Security & Privacy, by strengthening our Cyber Security governance by developing policies, standards, and processes that support a secure and compliant business environment. You will partner with internal teams and external stakeholders to support security audits, certifications, regulatory compliance and overall trust in our security program.

- Develop, publish, and maintain security policies, standards, and guidelines that are easy to adopt and aligned with international best practices

- A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Cyber Security Law or related field of study
- At least 3 or more years of experience in Security Governance, Cyber security, Information Security
- Proven ability to build, implement, and maintain security governance frameworks in a complex, international organization and experience in environments with stringent security needs, such as manufacturing, laboratories, or high security operations

- Experience with (inter)national regulations and standards (e.g. NIS2, ISO27001, TISAX, PCI DSS, DFARS, Common Criteria, GSMA) in cyber security and adjacent areas

postings.title: Cyber Security Consultant - Identity and Access Management (f/m/div)
postings.description:
#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone’s life

Behind every success, there is a plan: your strategic thinking, creative skills, and ability to communicate with others will drive innovation and turn ideas into impact.

As a Cyber Security Consultant - Identity and Access Management in our Corporate team, you’ll play a vital part in building the frameworks, relationships, and processes that keep Infineon’s Business thriving.

Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role
As a Cyber Security Consultant - Identity and Access Management, you will play a key role in our Business Technology team within Corporate Cyber Security & Privacy. You’ll be the go-to expert for Identity & Access Management (IAM), shaping secure solutions, setting IAM standards, driving risk assessments, and influencing cutting-edge architectural decisions to protect and future-proof critical systems.

- Act as a trusted subject matter expert for Identity & Access Management, advising architecture, engineering, and operational teams on the secure design, implementation, and operation of identity services and access control mechanisms
- Define and establish IAM-related security controls that reflect current threats, emerging technologies, and modern Zero Trust and identity-centric security models
- Advise on and establish consistent IAM standards, patterns, and best practices across Infineon departments, covering authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, and privileged access
- Lead and facilitate risk assessments, threat modelling, and secure design reviews for business-critical systems, platforms, and services (e.g., cloud, manufacturing, R&D platforms)
- Partner with enterprise architects, domain architects, and service owners to translate IAM security controls into functional and non-functional requirements
- Influence and challenge architectural and design decisions by balancing risks, business value, operational resilience, and engineering feasibility

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed
You are a proactive and solutions-driven professional with strong communication skills, able to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and articulate ideas clearly in an international environment. With a customer-focused mindset and a drive to identify challenges, push initiatives forward, and continuously improve, you thrive in a role where critical thinking and innovation shape the way ahead.

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, IT Security or related field of study
- Deep expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, federation concepts, and IAM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Active Directory/Entra ID)
- Strong knowledge of identity-related security controls for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, including identity providers, directory services, and access management platforms
- Advanced IAM architecture and system design skills, covering modern access control models, session management, API access security, and service-to-service identity
- Experience performing cybersecurity risk assessments, threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE), across software and infrastructure systems
- Strong understanding of security principles (least privilege, ZeroTrust, defense in depth, trust boundaries), and cryptographic concepts relevant to IAM (e.g., token signing, certificate-based authentication, key management)
- Proven experience aligning IAM controls with enterprise risk management, compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 29146), regulatory expectations, and audit requirements
- In-depth knowledge of IAM capabilities for modern cloud-native and distributed platforms, including token-based authentication, just-in-time access, workload identity, and federation protocols
- Fluency in English (mandatory)

Please send us your CV in English.

For Austria:

We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2022/05/minimumsalaries-white-collar-workers-2023.pdf). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.
